And Sam Rayburn is a great man--one who will go down in American history as a truly great leader of the Nation. He will be considered not only great among his contemporaries, but as great among all the Americans who have played a part in the country's history since the beginning.

message.content: Sam Rayburn is a great man, and history will remember him as one of the Nation's great leaders. He will rank as great not only among the people of his own time but among all the Americans who have shaped the country since its founding.
